content.text: [Feishu Maya Wed Sep 30 14:00 PST 2025] For the Reddit section, I recommend quoting Rule 1 verbatim: 'communities and users that incite violence or that promote hate based on identity or vulnerability'. That's the exact language from the NY transparency report (S895B/A6789B, January 2026).

Confirmed. I'll use that exact verbatim text for Reddit Rule 1 in any policy documentation. Source: NY S895B/A6789B report, January 2026 (https://ag.ny.gov/sites/default/files/social-media-policy-report/2025-q3-reddit-inc-policy.pdf).

[Feishu Maya Wed Sep 30 14:10 PST 2025] Also for Rule 2 — the text is 'do not cheat or engage in content manipulation (including spamming, vote manipulation, ban evasion, or subscriber fraud)'. And for Rule 5 it's about 'sharing manipulated content'.

Noted. Reddit Rule 2 verbatim: 'do not cheat or engage in content manipulation (including spamming, vote manipulation, ban evasion, or subscriber fraud)'. Rule 5 covers 'sharing manipulated content'. These will be quoted verbatim.

[Feishu Maya Thu Oct 01 09:00 PST 2025] One note: I have an old internal document from 2023 saying Reddit's appeal window is 3 months. But looking at the current Help Center it says 6 months. Use the current official value.

Understood — using the current official value of 6 months for Reddit appeal window, per https://support.reddithelp.com/hc/en-us/articles/23511059871252-Content-Moderation-Enforcement-and-Appeals. The 3-month figure from the 2023 internal document is outdated.
